newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lend Lease in talks on U.S. purchase.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lend Lease in talks on U.S. purchase.

text.p: Property and insurance group Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Monday it had entered preliminary negotiations with The Equitable Companies Inc of the United States over the potential acquisition of Equitable Real Estate Investment Management Inc (ERE).
Lend Lease said no binding agreement had been reached and any such agreement would be subject to approval by regulatory authorities.
If the deal was completed, ERE would continue to manage the Equitable General Accont real estate portfolio, which has a current value of about US$5 billion, it said.
Lend Lease said it was pursuing the establishment of a global real estate investment management operation.
"The acquisition of ERE would be consistent with this objective," it said in a statement.
ERE is the largest U.S. manager of real estate equity and mortgage investments on behalf of pension funds and other institutions, with about US$25 billion of funds under management, Lend Lease said.
